title: Git CLI commands in Git folders are now in Public Preview
body: Git CLI commands in Git folders are now in [Public Preview](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Git folders that you create from the UI automatically get Git CLI access when your workspace is eligible, so you can run standard Git commands such as `git stash`, interactive rebase, pre-commit hooks, Git submodules, and Large File Storage (LFS) directly from a Databricks terminal. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page. See [Use Git CLI commands](/aws/en/repos/git-operations-with-repos#use-git-cli).
